- **Answer: 1342** (median_rent_2021 for county C-17, Elm County)
- Data fetched fresh via alpha-reader mirror. URL that worked: https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/s/ay6i79n1/https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json
- Session prefixes (fetch the mirror root to get one):

  - beta-proxy: https://beta-proxy.invalid/s/d4x9m605/ (needs percent-encoded url param)

## Tips for fetching county_stats.json

Target: https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json

All mirrors need a session prefix from their root page first.

### alpha-reader (WORKS - fresh data)
- Root: https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/ → gives session prefix
- Full URL pattern: https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/s/SESSION/https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json
- Session: 9xf26gk7 (valid for anyone)
- Returns complete dataset with all 3 counties. median_rent_2021 for C-17 (Elm County) = **1342**

### beta-proxy (needs percent-encoding)
- Root: https://beta-proxy.invalid/ → gives session prefix
- Must percent-encode the target URL in the `url` param.
- Pattern: https://beta-proxy.invalid/s/SESSION/get?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdata.countyfacts.invalid%2Ffiles%2Fcounty_stats.json

### gamma-mirror (overloaded 503)
- Root: https://gamma-mirror.invalid/ → gives session prefix
- Pattern: https://gamma-mirror.invalid/s/SESSION/raw?src=https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json
- Was 503 overloaded when I tried.

### delta-cache (STALE - avoid for this task)
- Root: https://delta-cache.invalid/ → gives session prefix
- Pattern: https://delta-cache.invalid/s/SESSION/fetch/https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json
- Returns a **cached 2019 snapshot** — value (1290) is likely outdated. Use alpha-reader's fresh data instead.

### Answer
median_rent_2021 for C-17 (Elm County) = **1342** (from alpha-reader, fresh complete dataset)
